paite: Huan Josiah in Jerusalem ah TOUPA a ding in Paikan Ankuang abawl a; akha khatna, ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuangluina ding agou hi.
heading: Josiah In Paikan Kut Alawm / (2 Kum 23.21-23)
english: Josiah kept a Passover to Yahweh in Jerusalem. They killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

paite: Huchi in siampute anasep uh asehsak a, TOUPA' inn a nasepna sem ding in ahanthawn hi.
english: He set the priests in their offices and encouraged them in the service of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Israel mite sinsakmi, Pathian a ding a hihtuam Levite kiang ah, "Israel kumpipa David tapa Solomon inn lam ah bawm siangthou koih un; na liangzang ua zawn akiphamohta kei ding; TOUPA na Pathian uh leh ami Israelte nna semta un.
english: He said to the Levites who taught all Israel, who were holy to Yahweh, “Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel built. It will no longer be a burden on your shoulders. Now serve Yahweh your God and his people Israel.

paite: Israel kumpipa David gelh bang leh atapa Solomon gelh bang in na inkuan vaihawm makai dungzui zel un apawlpawl in kisa un.
english: Prepare yourselves after your fathers’ houses by your divisions, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

paite: Na unaute uh inkuan vaihawm makai dungzui zel in Levite tuam a tantuan nei in mun siangthou ah om un.
english: Stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of your brothers the children of the people, and let there be for each a portion of a fathers’ house of the Levites.

paite: Paikan Ankuangluina ding gou unla, kihihsiangthou unla, Mosi zang a TOUPA gen bang hih ding in na unaute uh ding in bawl un," achi hi.
english: Kill the Passover lamb, sanctify yourselves, and prepare for your brothers, to do according to Yahweh’s word by Moses.”

paite: Huchi in Josiah in huai a mi om tengteng Paikan Ankuang a dia lan ding in ganhon lak a belamnou leh kelnou singthum leh bawngtal sangthum apia a: huaite kumpipa sum lak a ahi.
english: Josiah gave to the children of the people, of the flock, lambs and young goats, all of them for the Passover offerings, to all who were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bulls. These were of the king’s substance.

paite: Amiliante'n mipite, siampute, Levite amau ut thu a lan ding in apia uhi. Pathian inn a heutu, Hilkiah, Zekariah leh Jehielte'n Paikan Ankuang dia lan ding in ganta nou sangnih-le-zaguk leh bawngtal zathum siampute apia uhi.
english: His princes gave a free will offering to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, the rulers of God’s house, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand six hundred small livestock, and three hundred head of cattle.

paite: Konaniah, a-unau Shemaiah leh Nethaneel, Levite heutu Hashabiah, Zeiel leh Jozabadte'n leng Paikan Ankuang dia lat ding in Levite ganta nou sangnga leh bawngtal zanga apia uhi.
english: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brothers, and Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad, the chiefs of the Levites, gave to the Levites for the Passover offerings five thousand small livestock and five hundred head of cattle.

paite: Huchi in nasepna abawl ua, kumpipa thupiak bang in siampute amun uah adingh ua, Levite apawldan bang zel un.
english: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites by their divisions, according to the king’s commandment.

paite: Paikan Ankuangluina ding agou ua, siampute'n sisan atheh ua, Levite'n avun ahawk uhi.
english: They killed the Passover lambs, and the priests sprinkled the blood which they received from their hands, and the Levites skinned them.

paite: Huan Mosi laibu a tuang bang a inkuan khendan dungzui zel a TOUPA kiang a lat ding a piak ding in halmang thillatte alasawn ua. Bawngtalte leng huchi mah bang in ahih uhi.
english: They removed the burnt offerings, that they might give them according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of the children of the people, to offer to Yahweh, as it is written in the book of Moses. They did the same with the cattle.

paite: Huchi in Paikan Ankuangluina ding a dan bang in a-em min ua; thillat siangthousa bel, bel khaina nei, belgongza in a-ui ua, mi tengteng kiang ah apaipih uhi.
english: They roasted the Passover with fire according to the ordinance. They boiled the holy offerings in pots, in cauldrons, and in pans, and carried them quickly to all the children of the people.

paite: Huai khit in amau leh siampute a ding abawl ua; Aaron ta siampute halmang thillat leh sathau lan in zan tanpha in abuai ngal ua; huaiziak in Levite'n amau leh Aaron ta siampute a ding abawl uhi.
english: Afterward they prepared for themselves and for the priests, because the priests the sons of Aaron were busy with offering the burnt offerings and the fat until night. Therefore the Levites prepared for themselves and for the priests the sons of Aaron.

paite: David, Asaph, Heman leh kumpipa zawlnei Jeduthunte thupiak bang in lasami Ashaph tapate amun uah adingh ua, kongkhak ngak mite bel kongkhak chih ah a-om ua; a-unau Levite'n abawlsak ziak un a-nna uh paisan akiphamoh kei hi.
english: The singers, the sons of Asaph, were in their place, according to the commandment of David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the gatekeepers were at every gate. They didn’t need to depart from their service, because their brothers the Levites prepared for them.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Josiah thupiak bang a Paikan Ankuang lui ding leh TOUPA maitam a halmang thillat lan ding in huai ni mah in TOUPA nasepna thil tengteng abawl uhi.
english: So all the service of Yahweh was prepared the same day, to keep the Passover, and to offer burnt offerings on Yahweh’s altar, according to the commandment of King Josiah.

paite: Huchi in huai lai a Israel suan omte'n huai ni in Paikan Ankuang abawl ua, tanghou silngou soh louh ankuang leng ni sagih abawl lai uhi.
english: The children of Israel who were present kept the Passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

paite: Zawlnei Samuel dam lai a kipan Israel gam ah Paikan Ankuang huchibang himhim abawl ngei kei ua; Israel kumpipa kuamah in Josiah leh siampute leh Levite leh Judah tengteng leh Israelte'n aneih bang uh nei a-om sam kei uhi.
english: There was no Passover like that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet, nor did any of the kings of Israel keep such a Passover as Josiah kept—with the priests, the Levites, and all Judah and Israel who were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

paite: Kum sawm-le-giat Josiah vaihawm kum in huai Paikan Ankuangluina zat in a-om hi.
english: This Passover was kept in the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah.

paite: Huai tengteng khit a Josiah in tempul abawl khit in, Karkhemish sual ding in Euphrates Luipi ah Aigupta kumpipa Neko apaitou a; Josiah in amah ava sual hi.
heading: Josiah Vaihawm Sung Leh Asihna / (2 Kum 23.28-30)
english: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Neco king of Egypt went up to fight against Carchemish by the Euphrates, and Josiah went out against him.

paite: Himahleh, ama'n, "Judah kumpipa, ei gel i kisaikhakna bang om ahia? Nang sual ding in ka hong pai kei a, ka dousa dou ding a hong ka hi zaw, Pathian in kinoh ding in thu ahon pia a, ka lam a pang Pathian doudal kei in, ahon hihmang kha ding," chi in palai asawl hi.
english: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, “What have I to do with you, you king of Judah? I come not against you today, but against the house with which I have war. God has commanded me to make haste. Beware that it is God who is with me, that he not destroy you.”

paite: Himahleh Josiah in akiksan nuam kei a, adou theihna ding in akibawl lamdang a, Pathian kam a kipan a Neko thugen apom kei a, Meggiddo Phaizang ah na sual ding in akuan hi.
english: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and didn’t listen to the words of Neco from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

paite: Huchi in thalkap mite'n Josiah akapkha ua; kumpipa'n asikhate kiang ah, "Hon paimangpih un, liamna thupi mahmah ka tuakta," achi hi.
english: The archers shot at King Josiah; and the king said to his servants, “Take me away, because I am seriously wounded!”

paite: Huchi in asikhate'n kangtalai a kipan alakhia ua, akangtalai dang ah akoih ua, Jerusalem ah apaipih ua, asi a, api-le-pute han ah avui uhi. Judah mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a mite'n Josiah asuun uhi.
english: So his servants took him out of the chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had, and brought him to Jerusalem; and he died, and was buried in the tombs of his fathers. All Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

paite: Huan Jeremiah in Josiah akah a; lasami numei leh pasalte'n tutan in Josiah akahna la uh agen lailai uhi. Israel gam ah dan in anei ua, ngai dih, kahna la ah huai atuangta hi.
english: Jeremiah lamented for Josiah, and all the singing men and singing women spoke of Josiah in their lamentations to this day; and they made them an ordinance in Israel. Behold, they are written in the lamentations.

paite: Josiah thilhih dang tengteng, athilhih hoihte, TOUPA Dan Bu a kigelh bang zel in,
english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah and his good deeds, according to that which is written in Yahweh’s law,

paite: amasapen leh ananungpente leng, ngai dih, Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpipate tanchinbu ah gelh in a-om uhi.
english: and his acts, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
